_doc: security-hardening 10, F4: what reaches each front-door route's upstream, per identity header. removed: dropped from the request. replaced: the ext_authz check's 200 always carries it, and Envoy overwrites the client's value. kept: passed through. Read by nix/portal/envoy-spec.nix (rendered by test/portal-envoy/portal_envoy.py) and by the gate's Rust tests (Route::replaced), so a header added to the gate is one new row here. x-agent-session-id is kept on rpc: the portal stamps the session id it learned from WhoAmI, and the agent partitions by the token's own sid, so the header only satisfies identity_policy's presence check; S31's cookie mode has the gate replace it.
